rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family only through its broad `core/view/**` selector. Every file in this change is under core/view: the new core/view/include/pulp/view/overlay_dismissal.hpp and core/view/src/overlay_dismissal.cpp, the two platform macOS hosts, the Windows plugin input router header, the web event-translation header, pointer_dispatch.{hpp,cpp}, and the view source manifest. Nothing under core/canvas or core/render is touched, no Skia, Dawn, or render-backend selector is crossed, no design-system asset changes, and no packaging or asset-resolution behaviour changes. The change consolidates four hand-rolled copies of the overlay-dismissal policy into one implementation the platform hosts call: route_press_to_active_overlay and route_context_press move unchanged out of pointer_dispatch.cpp, route_escape_to_active_overlay is added and carries the Escape ordering the standalone macOS host previously spelled out inline, and root_has_dismissible_overlay answers the same question without acting so a plugin host can decide whether to hold the DAW keyboard. The behavioural deltas are that the standalone and web hosts now read the root-owned overlay slot instead of the process-global shim mirror, the web host routes a press into the overlay's own subtree and honours outside-click consumption, and both DAW plugin hosts gain an Escape path they did not have. No rendering, paint, layout, or asset behaviour changes, no accepted expansion boundary moves, and no Vellum source authority changes.
